description: KERNEL verification framework: domain-independent gates and evidence base types. Domain packages add gates, specialized evidence types (each extending a base type) and task-type requirements. Human-readable source: docs/VERIFICATION.md.

evidence_base_types.check_result: an executed check with a pass/fail outcome (procedure, exit status, log)
evidence_base_types.artifact: a produced artifact plus what it should show (image, report, dataset)
evidence_base_types.measurement: a metric with baseline and threshold
evidence_base_types.review: an independent reviewer's findings and verdict
evidence_base_types.scope_inspection: what changed versus the declared resource scope
evidence_base_types.observation: a recorded observation of system or world state, with source and time

gates.name: Scope and hygiene
gates.passes_when: Changes touch only the declared resource scope; no secrets exposed; no protected resources changed.

gates.name: Independent review
gates.passes_when: Independent review stance approves; findings addressed or waived with log.

gates.name: Documents and artifacts
gates.passes_when: Artifact validators pass; internal references resolve; review confirms the content addresses the task.
